att.converged_detail: The attitude filter has converged; readings can be used to judge dish orientation
att.convergence_warning_detail: The filter is not stable yet and readings keep drifting; please wait a few seconds
att.initializing_detail: The dish just powered up and is establishing an attitude reference
att.reset_detail: A move or reboot was detected; recalibrating
att.invalid_detail: The device self-test failed; power-cycle the dish
att.unreported_detail: The device has not reported an attitude estimate; check the dish connection
att.unknown_detail: The current firmware reported a state this app does not recognize

verdict.calibrating_detail: The attitude sensor is not ready yet, so the pointer drifts. Wait until the state becomes “ready”.
verdict.missing_expected_detail: The device has not reported the recommended orientation or elevation, so alignment cannot be judged automatically
verdict.aligned_detail: Orientation and elevation are both within the recommended range; you can fix the mount

guidance.no_expected_band: The device has not reported a recommended orientation
guidance.no_expected_band_tilt: The device has not reported a recommended elevation

flash.detail: Orientation and elevation are within the recommended range

usage.title: How to read this chart
usage.band_desc: The <arc>outer bright arc</arc> marks the recommended range (target ± {{tol}}, i.e. {{total}} wide in total). The <band>inner band</band> is the recommended range itself:
usage.band_in_band: Grey means out of band, green means in band.
usage.band_no_band: The device has not reported expected values, so no recommended range is drawn.
usage.pointer: The orange pointer shows where the dish is actually pointing. Once in band it turns green and the dial centre tells you how many degrees to rotate east and how much to raise; the small triangle outside the ring indicates the direction to turn.
usage.tilt: The TILT dial pointer is the beam elevation, in the same coordinate system as the device's target elevation. The physical tilt angle at the bottom is a different quantity; the two differ by a fixed installation offset and are for reference only.
